description: NOTHING IS IMPOSSIBLE FOR PRIME AUTOBOTS!!!
summary:
Our application is an astronomy tool that provides users with information on how they can study and observe objects in the universe. Such information includes the coordinates of an object, its size, the distance from Earth, and its magnitude, along with the visual representation of how its location will change over time. In addition, our project allows observing the movement of the object and predicting its possible future locations.

Information on the objects in the universe may be hard to find and analyze when presented separately or without any explanation. Our project provides the combination of important information and visual representation of the movement of the object, which makes it easier for users to investigate the past and future movements of the object.
details:
With our application, people have the ability to discover objects in the Universe through information on their coordinates, sizes, distance from Earth, and magnitude. In addition, users have the opportunity to observe how the positions of objects change over time, watch their current movements, and explore their predicted movements in the future.

This application allows you to easily observe and trace the trajectory of objects, both the previous and the forecasted movements. This application may be helpful in encouraging your curiosity and learning, because all astronomical information is concentrated in this app.

For planning, designing, developing, and managing our project, we used AI systems such as ChatGPT, Claude, Antigravity, VS Code, Google Stitch, GitHub, Manus.

All the information about objects, their timelines, and movements is combined in one application. During our work on the project, we tried to consider how it would be possible to provide clear and useful information about astronomy objects.
